reports.title: Globus Medical Reports Third Quarter 2026 Results and Announces a $500 Million Increase to the Share Repurchase Program

guidance.heading: 2026 Annual Guidance
section: The Company is updating its guidance for full-year 2026 revenue to $3.09 billion from the previous range of $3.18 billion to $3.22 billion, representing 5.1% revenue growth as compared to fiscal 2025. The Company reaffirms its full-year fiscal 2026 non-GAAP fully diluted EPS guidance to be in the range of $4.95 to $5.05, representing 24.4% to 26.9% growth over fiscal 2025 non-GAAP fully diluted EPS.
